observations: The authentic family is warm ivory with dark brown/black contour linework, restrained but real drapery/chasuble contour, original altar architecture, not navy geometric block pictograms.
The old priest_kiss_altar_rich master is the nearest in-family pose, but using it unchanged as profound bow would misrepresent distinct bow/kiss actions.
The generative B16 image recreated a new frontal altar composition and ornate lace/columns, inconsistent with actual donor altar and artist.
The next generative attempt reverted to a navy thurible image, not a B16 bow; excluded from candidate set.

A mechanically faithful image would retain the original priest and altar pixels outside the gesture regions and modify head/neck/hand contact deliberately, with the separation from altar visually readable at mobile size.
No new artwork has passed the family-parity or rubric-accuracy gate; no icon should be activated.
recommendation: Use original visual donor for manual source-preserving edit or keep a short source-owned bow rubric until specific artwork is approved; no new generated family.
